services.name: Park City “Night Rider” Mountain Bike Ride
services.desc: Park City “Night Rider” Rates: $85 per Rider Park City “Night Rider” Details: 2 person minimum. Name says it all. We’ll provide a light, bike if needed, and we ride into the night Enjoy over 500 miles of the best single track trail system in the US. Come see why the International Mountain Biking Association (IMBA) has made Park City the world’s one and only “Gold” level Ride Center destination. We consider ourselves cyclists. We offer a great experience for the beginner to the expert level mountain biking in the Wasatch Mountains. If you are new to the area or just want to brush up on your skills, we also offer lessons. Our Lead Guide is also IMBA ICP
